title: Candidate Sub-Surfaces, ContextSwitcher & Command Palette Deep Polish
spec:
# DIR-002: Candidate Sub-Surfaces, ContextSwitcher & Command Palette Deep Polish

## 1. Executive Context & Objectives
The Candidate Workspace is the core candidate touchpoint in ResumePilotAI. While main routes (/candidate/dashboard, /candidate/resumes) are operational, several sub-surfaces (profile edit tabs, career goal trackers, quick resume preview drawer, and the ContextSwitcher dropdown) suffer from inconsistent styling, missing Cuba M3 tokens, or broken keyboard navigation.

This directive mandates a 10/10 comprehensive overhaul of all candidate sub-surfaces, the global ContextSwitcher, and the universal Command Palette (⌘K / Ctrl+K) integration, ensuring fluid transitions, keyboard accessibility, and cohesive design token usage.

## 2. Architectural Directives
1. **ContextSwitcher Polish**:
   - Ensure the organization/profile switcher in the candidate header smoothly switches contexts without page reload.
   - Display active candidate tier (Free, Pro, Enterprise Candidate), with badges styled using Cuba tokens.
   - Provide instant keyboard navigation (Arrow Up/Down, Enter, Esc) with aria-haspopup="listbox" and role="option".

2. **Candidate Sub-Surfaces Refinement**:
   - **Profile Edit Sub-Tabs**: Personal Info, Social Links, Work Preferences, Career Objectives, Privacy. Ensure each tab maintains state, validates inputs with live feedback, and provides clear save/cancel actions.
   - **Resume Quick Drawer**: Provide a slide-over preview pane for any resume directly from the dashboard or resumes list without full page navigation.
   - **Activity Feed & Goal Tracker**: Align all timeline cards with Cuba M3 executive glassmorphic card styling, featuring micro-interactions and status badges.

3. **Command Palette Integration**:
   - Register all candidate actions in the universal ⌘K command palette: 'Create New Resume', 'Browse Jobs', 'Open AI Interview Coach', 'Edit Profile', 'Toggle Theme', 'View Applications'.
   - Include fuzzy search matching, recent action history, and keyboard shortcuts display.

## 3. Acceptance Criteria
1. ContextSwitcher supports keyboard navigation (Arrow keys, Esc, Enter) with full ARIA attributes.
2. All Candidate sub-tabs load and persist changes cleanly to MariaDB/Firestore without full page reloads.
3. Quick Resume Drawer opens smoothly via CSS transform, traps focus properly, and closes on Esc or backdrop click.
4. Command Palette (⌘K) triggers candidate-specific actions instantly and navigates to the respective sub-surfaces.
5. All elements strictly use Cuba CSS variables (var(--cuba-bg-surface), var(--cuba-border-default), etc.) with zero hardcoded ad-hoc styles.
6. Responsive behavior verified across desktop (1440px), tablet (768px), and mobile (375px).

## 4. Strict Invariants
1. Do not break existing candidate auth state or JWT tokens in localStorage.
2. Ensure backward compatibility with existing resume IDs and profile schemas.
3. No layout shift (CLS < 0.05) when toggling drawers or switching tabs.
4. WCAG 2.1 AA minimum contrast (4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for UI controls) in both light and dark modes.
invariants: Preserve existing candidate profile schema and data contracts
Zero layout shift (CLS < 0.05) on drawer/tab transitions
Maintain strict WCAG 2.1 AA contrast ratios across light and dark themes
Do not alter authentication state handling or token refresh cycles
acceptanceCriteria: ContextSwitcher handles keyboard navigation with full ARIA compliance
All Candidate sub-tabs persist data smoothly without layout jump or reload
Quick Resume Drawer provides fast preview with proper focus trapping
Command Palette exposes all candidate actions with fuzzy search
Complete Cuba M3 tokenization across all sub-surfaces
Responsive verification passes on 1440px, 768px, and 375px viewports
